transcript.text: Can you tell me more about your role running the remedial-learning programme in 18 government schools?

I taught for four years at a private school in Hyderabad and for the last two years I've coordinated a remedial-learning programme for an education NGO. It runs in 18 government schools, four field staff report to me, and we manage Rs 55 lakh from two donors. Over two years the share of children reading at grade level went from 31% to 48%. I'm applying for an MBA because I know how learning improves but I can't yet scale a programme or read a budget properly.
What strategies did you implement to raise the share of children reading at grade level from 31% to 48%?
transcript.anchor_quote: Over two years the share of children reading at grade level went from 31% to 48%

transcript.text: Education is the foundation of society. Through my work I try to empower children and create sustainable impact. I believe in holistic development and inclusive growth.
You mentioned holistic development and inclusive growth. Could you clarify the specific strategies or actions you and your team took to improve reading levels in these schools?
transcript.anchor_quote: Education is the foundation of society. Through my work I try to empower children and create sustainable impact

transcript.text: I don't know how the 48% figure compares with other NGOs working in the same districts. We compared ourselves only with our own baseline.
How did you measure the impact of these strategies on students' reading abilities over time?
I don't actually have anyone reporting to me. The four field staff report to the director, and I only share the schedule with them.
Could you clarify your role in managing the four field staff involved in the programme? How do you coordinate with them and what responsibilities do you hold regarding their work?
transcript.conflict: In the resume you said four field staff report to you, but now you say they report to the director and you only share schedules with them.

transcript.text: By the way, have you heard about the new metro line in Hyderabad? My commute to the schools could be shorter. I'm thinking of moving closer to the station.

feedback.summary: The candidate has relevant experience in education NGOs and demonstrated awareness of social impact goals but provided inconsistent details on leadership responsibilities and lacked specifics on project strategies and measurement. They appear motivated to expand skills in finance and program scaling but need to clarify their personal ownership and substantiate outcomes more clearly.

strengths.observation: Demonstrates experience coordinating a sizable education programme with multiple schools and a significant budget.
